A '''Root Oath''' was an [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] custom. [[Grael]] swore a Root Oath to [[Junas Turner]] to gain the assistance of the Ewoks against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in return for escaping [[Balis-Baurgh]] [[Balis-Baurgh prison|prison]].<ref name="EBB">{{JournalCite|1|Escape from Balis-Baurgh}}</ref>
